description: 2024 NCFO Operator Segment File is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by BTS National Census of Ferry Operators. A data base of responses to the 2024 National Census of Ferries. This file gives information about segments for particular operators. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 35 columns, among them vessel_id7, vessel_id6, vessel_id2, most_used_vessel_id, route_rate_regulator, trips_per_year. The portal shows 2026-06-10 as the last data update. Attribution given: BTS National Census of Ferry Operators. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
